source_contract_topics: Public rights of way and highway adoption
Hazardous substances and HSE land-use planning

source_contract_findings.lnrs: The 48 strategy areas, Greater London publication status, statutory local habitat map and biodiversity-priority components, and the duty to have regard were separated. Strategy mapping was not treated as planning permission, title, ecological survey, funding or delivered habitat.
source_contract_findings.minerals_coal: Mineral Safeguarding Areas, Mineral Consultation Areas, extraction permissions, the Coal Development High Risk Area and Coal Mining Risk Assessments were separated. Resource and coalfield geometry were not treated as title, extraction consent, measured ground defect, risk clearance or completed remediation.
source_contract_findings.suds: The seven national SuDS standards, LLFA and Environment Agency consultation roles, flood-risk-assessment triggers and the SWIM appraisal approach were separated. Guidance, consultation, triggers and business cases were not treated as an approved drainage design, funding award, adoption or delivery.
source_contract_findings.rights_highways: Definitive-map evidence, four public-right categories, legal order procedures and road adoption were separated. Web or Ordnance Survey depiction, an order application and a proposed adoption were not treated as a confirmed public right, private easement, highway extent or HMLR title.
source_contract_findings.hazardous_substances: Hazardous-substances consent, the hazardous substances authority and HSE roles, three consultation zones and the Planning Advice Web App were separated. Thresholds, zones and HSE advice were not treated as current inventory, title restriction, automatic refusal or the final planning decision.
source_contract_findings.waste: Waste planning policy, RPS, exemption, standard-rules and bespoke permits, permit applications, deposit-for-recovery evidence and compliance scoring were separated. Policy, application, recovery plans and permits were not treated as planning permission, title, completed operation, spare capacity or a parcel development score.
